_about: Traits that make a page look like every other generated page. They are taste: scripts/check_page.py only warns about them and a brief that asks for one of them wins. Fashions change, so review this list when it is more than six months old.

default_font_families.unit: first family in the computed font stack, lower case
default_font_families.source: mstack's own observation of generated pages, written 2026-11-22

max_font_sizes.unit: different text sizes in one view before a warning

min_readable_px.unit: CSS px; smaller text gets a warning

phone_max_width.unit: CSS px; views this narrow get the touch comfort warning

touch_comfort_px.source: platform guidance for touch targets as remembered (Apple 44 pt, Android 48 dp); a warning level only

default_gradient_hue_range.source: mstack's own observation of generated pages, written 2026-11-22
